scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.test: node scripts/check-worker.mjs && node scripts/check-frontend.mjs && node --test tests/unit/*.test.js
scripts.verify:production: npm run check:migrations && npm test && npm run test:design && npm run test:bootstrap-admin && npm run build && node scripts/check-build.mjs && node scripts/build-modern-preview.mjs
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check:migrations && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run verify:production && npm run deploy:cloudflare
